features.title: Multi-city engine: cities/<id>.json drives src, api and scripts
features.user_visible_behavior: One engine serves several cities; --city / npm run city selects the data.
verification: npm run verify -- --city guimaraes (data hosted here)
evidence: commit db0d201 (multi-city: cities/<id>.json drives src, api and scripts)
commit fa26211 (city configs braga, guimaraes, porto)
features.notes: The single-city forks (guimaraes-3d, porto-3d) copy this engine.

features.title: Braga city: 30 landmarks, RU/EN/PT content, credited photos, 1:1 models
features.user_visible_behavior: Braga renders with all 30 landmarks as recognisable 1:1 models and full cards.
evidence: check-data OK: 30 landmarks, 115 gallery photos, 6 panoramas, 72 videos, 3 routes
check-dimensions OK: 30 landmarks, all numbers finite, positive and sourced
check-fit OK: all landmarks within tolerance; no model smaller than real
check-models OK: total 513,554 tris (budget 600k), each model 4k..40k
features.notes: Total triangle budget is close to 600k — watch it when adding models.
